text: Command Code Go for DSH 是面向 DSH Web 和 TUI 的模型提供商插件。它向 DSH 注册 Command Code 模型目录和适配器，通过流式请求将文本及图像输入发送到 Command Code，并把响应转换为 DSH 可处理的文本、推理和工具调用事件。插件还提供 /cc-usage 与 /ccusage 命令，读取并展示套餐余额、滚动用量限制和订阅周期。适合希望在 DSH 中使用 Command Code 提供的多家模型，或查看账号额度的用户。使用前需要配置 COMMANDCODE_API_KEY。

Command Code Go for DSH adds a model provider for DSH Web and TUI. It registers Command Code models and streams text, reasoning, and tool-call responses. Use /cc-usage or /ccusage to view plan credits and rolling limits. Configure COMMANDCODE_API_KEY.

Command Code Go for DSH 的功能「模型接入」：在 DSH 注册 Command Code 模型提供商、模型发现和适配器，列出可选模型并支持流式生成。用户在模型选择界面选择 Command Code 模型后即可调用。
Command Code Go for DSH 的功能「套餐用量查询」：通过 DSH 主机命令 /cc-usage 或 /ccusage 查询并格式化显示套餐 credits、五小时和每周限制及重置时间；可用信息由账号订阅返回决定。
Command Code Go for DSH 的功能「流式响应转换」：处理 Command Code 的 NDJSON 事件流，将文本、推理过程、工具调用、用量和结束状态转换为 DSH 适配器事件。
Command Code Go for DSH 使用前须知：模型请求和额度查询会向 api.commandcode.ai 发送请求，调用需要 COMMANDCODE_API_KEY；模型请求包含会话输入及认证信息。

commandcode-go-for-dsh README · commandcode-go-for-dsh：Command Code Go as a model provider in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Works on the official **Web** UI (`dsh web`) and the community **TUI** (`dsh --profile tui`).

Port of [`commandcode-go-for-pi`](https://github.com/gonegirl07/commandcode-go-for-pi) plus [`commandcode-usage-for-pi`](https://github.com/gonegirl07/commandcode-usage-for-pi):

commandcode-go-for-dsh README · commandcode-go-for-dsh：- Route `commandcode` calls `POST https://api.commandcode.ai/alpha/generate`.
- Host slash commands `/cc-usage` and `/ccusage` print plan credits and rolling limits.

Unofficial. Not affiliated with Command Code or DeepSeek. `/alpha` is undocumented and can change.

Ubuntu install script and guide: [deepseek-harness-ubuntu](https://github.com/gonegirl07/deepseek-harness-ubuntu).

commandcode-go-for-dsh README · Install：Add the plugin to **each** profile you use. Settings and credentials are shared; plugins are not.

```console
dsh plugin --profile tui add github:gonegirl07/commandcode-go-for-dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:gonegirl07/commandcode-go-for-dsh
```

Restart the app after install (`dsh --profile tui` or `dsh web`). Refresh the browser if Web was already open.

commandcode-go-for-dsh README · Install：`dsh web` listens on `127.0.0.1` only. Other LAN devices cannot open it unless you SSH-tunnel or bind a specific LAN IP (not `0.0.0.0` — DSH rejects that). LAN notes live in the [Ubuntu install guide](https://github.com/gonegirl07/deepseek-harness-ubuntu).

commandcode-go-for-dsh README · Auth：A `user_...` key from [Command Code settings](https://commandcode.ai/settings). Never commit it.

```bash
export COMMANDCODE_API_KEY="user_..."
```

Or `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` (mode `600`):

```yaml
COMMANDCODE_API_KEY: user_...
```

commandcode-go-for-dsh README · Pick a model：Useful defaults: `deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro`, `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash`.

| Surface | How |
| --- | --- |
| TUI | `/model` → Command Code Go → `s` (first row is Pro) |
| Web | Settings → Models, or the composer model picker |

The plugin seeds the official Command Code catalog (DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, MiMo, Qwen, Step, Hy3, Nemotron, Inkling, Laguna, Fugu, Muse Spark, plus Claude / GPT / Gemini / Grok). Closed-source ids often need Pro/Max.

Optional default (no secrets):

```yaml

commandcode-go-for-dsh README · ~/.dsh/settings.yaml：agent-default-model:
  provider: commandcode
  model: deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro
  reasoningEffort: high
```

commandcode-go-for-dsh README · Usage：In the TUI prompt or the Web composer:

```
/cc-usage
```

`/ccusage` is the same host command (not a model prompt). It must appear in the `/` menu. If it does not, restart `dsh web` and refresh.

```
Command Code  individual-go
Month   $8.77 / $10 left
5-hour  $0.14 / $3    reset Aug 16, 19:15
Week    $1.23 / $6    reset Aug 22, 10:44

commandcode-go-for-dsh README · Reasoning：DeepSeek V4 Pro / Flash accept only these levels:

| DSH | Request |
| --- | --- |
| `off` | omit `params.reasoning_effort` |
| `high` | `params.reasoning_effort: "high"` |
| `max` | `params.reasoning_effort: "max"` |

Other levels are not forwarded. Pro still thinks when effort is omitted.

commandcode-go-for-dsh README · Remove：```console
dsh plugin --profile tui remove commandcode-go-for-dsh
dsh plugin --profile web remove commandcode-go-for-dsh
```
